The execution failed because the required output file '/root/clinic_intake_ready.hwpx' was not created.
The pytest suite failed with multiple FileNotFoundError and AssertionError instances. Specifically, 'test_output_exists_and_is_zip' failed because 'OUTPUT_FILE.exists()' returned False for '/root/clinic_intake_ready.hwpx'. Subsequent tests 'test_required_values_present_and_repeated_value_updated' and 'test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache' failed while attempting to open the missing file using 'zipfile.ZipFile(hwpx_path)'.
